intro.title: The smart plant timelapse camera for people who love plants.
intro.p1: BloomCam is a premium smart plant timelapse camera — a lifestyle desk gadget that records your plant's growth and turns it into cinematic timelapse videos. It is designed for plant lovers, indoor gardeners, and content creators — not for home security or surveillance.
intro.p2: Place BloomCam beside your monstera, pothos, or succulent. The device captures frames over days and weeks. The BloomCam mobile app (iOS and Android) compiles growth into share-ready timelapses for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.
intro.p3: Category: plant timelapse camera, smart plant camera, indoor gardening tech, aesthetic desk accessory.

about.title: Cinematic stories for quiet, living things.
about.p1: We believe plants are characters — not background decor. BloomCam exists to honor patience: the unfurl of a leaf, the reach toward light, the slow drama of growth.
about.p2: Our hardware is calm and sculptural. Our software feels like a gallery, not a dashboard. We refuse the surveillance-camera aesthetic — BloomCam belongs on beautiful desks, in sunlit rooms, and in creator workflows.
about.trustBody: BloomCam films your plant — not your home. Clips are for timelapse storytelling and personal journals, with cloud sync you control from the app.

what.a: BloomCam is a smart plant timelapse camera — a premium desk gadget that captures your plant's growth over time and creates cinematic timelapse videos via a mobile app. It is a lifestyle product for plant lovers, not a security camera.

who.a: BloomCam is for plant parents, indoor gardeners, aesthetic desk setup enthusiasts, and creators who want share-ready plant growth videos without complex editing.

surveillance.a: No. BloomCam is not designed for home security. It is a plant timelapse camera focused on growth storytelling, emotional desk decor, and mobile app export — not room monitoring.

how.a: Place BloomCam near your plant, connect to the BloomCam app over WiFi, and start capture. The device records growth frames on smart intervals, then compiles cinematic timelapses you can browse, journal, and export.

app.q: Does BloomCam have a mobile app?
app.a: Yes. BloomCam includes iOS and Android apps with a timelapse library, plant journal, growth insights, and one-tap export for Reels and TikTok.

export.q: Can I export videos for social media?
export.a: Yes. BloomCam exports vertical cinematic timelapses optimized for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and Stories.

wifi.a: WiFi is used to sync timelapses to your phone and cloud library. Setup is designed to take seconds from the app.

price.a: BloomCam pre-orders start at $99 for the first edition. See the pre-order section for shipping, returns, and warranty details.
